timeline.title: Maruti slips after 26% profit fall
timeline.line: Record volumes, but costs and mark-to-market losses hit Q2 profit
more: Q2 net profit ~₹2,466 cr, down 26%; revenue up 26% to ~₹53,355 cr
Shares fell as much as 1% to ₹11,335.75; analysts still see value after a 15% fall

src.title: Business Standard: Maruti dips marginally post Q2 amid cost pressures; analysts remain bullish
